long_biography.plain_text:
Swiftcover gave Philip William Henry James a way to challenge traditional motor insurers online. Primary Group, his insurance investment business, was the prime investor in the venture, which launched in 2005 as Britain's first exclusively internet-based insurer. AXA acquired it after rapid customer growth.

James repeated the model with QMetric and its consumer brand Policy Expert, combining insurance distribution with technology-led underwriting. Primary explored a sale as the business expanded across home and motor cover. In 2023, an Abu Dhabi Investment Authority subsidiary acquired a majority stake in Policy Expert's holding company. James left Primary Group after the transaction.
